</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Control Plane Subnet Information. This field is required only in the following scenarios: When the container network plugin is CiliumOverlay, TKE will obtain 2 IPs from this subnet to create an internal load balancer; When creating a managed cluster that supports CDC with the VPC-CNI network plugin, at least 12 IPs must be reserved.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusterversion_go">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusterversion_go" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Cluster<wbr>Version</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Version of the cluster. Use <code>tencentcloud.Kubernetes.getAvailableClusterVersions</code> to get the upgradable cluster version.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_containerruntime_go">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_containerruntime_go" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Container<wbr>Runtime</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Runtime type of the cluster, the available values include: 'docker' and 'containerd'.The Kubernetes v1.24 has removed dockershim, so please use containerd in v1.24 or higher. The default value is <code>docker</code> for versions below v1.24 and <code>containerd</code> for versions above v1.24.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_dataplanev2_go">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_dataplanev2_go" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Data<wbr>Plane<wbr>V2</a>

        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">bool</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Whether to enable DataPlaneV2 (replace kube-proxy with cilium). <code>dataPlaneV2</code> and <code>clusterIpvs</code> should not be set at the same time.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_deletionprotection_go">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_deletionprotection_go" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Deletion<wbr>Protection</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">bool</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Indicates whether cluster deletion protection is enabled. Default is false.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_disableaddons_go">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_disableaddons_go" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Disable<wbr>Addons</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">[]string</span>
    </dt>

            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_dockergraphpath_go">

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Docker graph path. Default is <code>/var/lib/docker</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_domain_go">

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Domain name for access.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_enablecustomizedpodcidr_go">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_enablecustomizedpodcidr_go" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Enable<wbr>Customized<wbr>Pod<wbr>Cidr</a>

        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">bool</span>

        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type"><a href="#clustereventpersistence">Cluster<wbr>Event<wbr>Persistence<wbr>Args</a></span>
    </dt>

            title="Optional">

        <span class="property-type"><a href="#clusterexistinstance">[]Cluster<wbr>Exist<wbr>Instance<wbr>Args</a></span>

            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_extensionaddons_go">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_extensionaddons_go" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Extension<wbr>Addons</a>

        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type"><a href="#clusterextensionaddon">[]Cluster<wbr>Extension<wbr>Addon<wbr>Args</a></span>

        <span id="state_isnonstaticipmode_go">

        <span class="property-type">bool</span>

    </dt>

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type"><a href="#clusterlogagent">Cluster<wbr>Log<wbr>Agent<wbr>Args</a></span>

            title="Optional, Deprecated">
        <span id="state_managedclusterinternetsecuritypolicies_go">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_managedclusterinternetsecuritypolicies_go" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Managed<wbr>Cluster<wbr>Internet<wbr>Security<wbr>Policies</a>

        <span class="property-indicator"></span>

    </dt>

Security policies for managed cluster internet, like:'192.168.1.0/24' or '113.116.51.27', '0.0.0.0/0' means all. This field can only set when field <code>clusterDeployType</code> is 'MANAGED_CLUSTER' and <code>clusterInternet</code> is true. <code>managedClusterInternetSecurityPolicies</code> can not delete or empty once be set.<p class="property-message">Deprecated: this argument was deprecated, use <code>clusterInternetSecurityGroup</code> instead.</p></dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"

<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_claimexpiredseconds_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">claim<wbr>Expired<wbr>Seconds</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Integer</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Claim expired seconds to recycle ENI. This field can only set when field <code>networkType</code> is 'VPC-CNI'. <code>claimExpiredSeconds</code> must greater or equal than 300 and less than 15768000.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-deprecated"
            title="Optional, Deprecated">
        <span id="state_clusterasenabled_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusterasenabled_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>As<wbr>Enabled</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>(<strong>Deprecated</strong>) This argument is deprecated because the TKE auto-scaling group was no longer available. Indicates whether to enable cluster node auto scaling. Default is false.<p class="property-message">Deprecated: This argument is deprecated because the TKE auto-scaling group was no longer available.</p></dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusteraudit_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusteraudit_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Audit</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type"><a href="#clusterclusteraudit">Cluster<wbr>Cluster<wbr>Audit</a></span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Specify Cluster Audit config. NOTE: Please make sure your TKE CamRole have permission to access CLS service.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clustercidr_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clustercidr_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Cidr</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>A network address block of the cluster. Different from vpc cidr and cidr of other clusters within this vpc. Must be in  10./192.168/172.[16-31] segments.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusterdeploytype_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusterdeploytype_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Deploy<wbr>Type</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Deployment type of the cluster, the available values include: 'MANAGED_CLUSTER' and 'INDEPENDENT_CLUSTER'. Default is 'MANAGED_CLUSTER'.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusterdesc_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusterdesc_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Desc</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Description of the cluster.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusterexternalendpoint_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusterexternalendpoint_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>External<wbr>Endpoint</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>External network address to access.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusterextraargs_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusterextraargs_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Extra<wbr>Args</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type"><a href="#clusterclusterextraargs">Cluster<wbr>Cluster<wbr>Extra<wbr>Args</a></span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Customized parameters for master component,such as kube-apiserver, kube-controller-manager, kube-scheduler.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusterinternet_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusterinternet_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Internet</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Open internet access or not. If this field is set 'true', the field below <code>workerConfig</code> must be set. Because only cluster with node is allowed enable access endpoint. You may open it through <code>tencentcloud.Kubernetes.ClusterEndpoint</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusterinternetdomain_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusterinternetdomain_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Internet<wbr>Domain</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Domain name for cluster Kube-apiserver internet access. Be careful if you modify value of this parameter, the clusterExternalEndpoint value may be changed automatically too.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusterinternetsecuritygroup_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusterinternetsecuritygroup_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Internet<wbr>Security<wbr>Group</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Specify security group, NOTE: This argument must not be empty if cluster internet enabled.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusterintranet_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusterintranet_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Intranet</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Open intranet access or not. If this field is set 'true', the field below <code>workerConfig</code> must be set. Because only cluster with node is allowed enable access endpoint. You may open it through <code>tencentcloud.Kubernetes.ClusterEndpoint</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusterintranetdomain_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusterintranetdomain_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Intranet<wbr>Domain</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Domain name for cluster Kube-apiserver intranet access. Be careful if you modify value of this parameter, the pgwEndpoint value may be changed automatically too.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusterintranetsubnetid_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusterintranetsubnetid_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Intranet<wbr>Subnet<wbr>Id</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Subnet id who can access this independent cluster, this field must and can only set  when <code>clusterIntranet</code> is true. <code>clusterIntranetSubnetId</code> can not modify once be set.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusteripvs_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusteripvs_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Ipvs</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Indicates whether <code>ipvs</code> is enabled. Default is true. False means <code>iptables</code> is enabled.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusterlevel_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusterlevel_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Level</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Specify cluster level, valid for managed cluster, use data source <code>tencentcloud.Kubernetes.getClusterLevels</code> to query available levels. Available value examples <code>L5</code>, <code>L20</code>, <code>L50</code>, <code>L100</code>, etc.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clustermaxpodnum_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clustermaxpodnum_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Max<wbr>Pod<wbr>Num</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Integer</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The maximum number of Pods per node in the cluster. Default is 256. The minimum value is 4. When its power unequal to 2, it will round upward to the closest power of 2.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clustermaxservicenum_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clustermaxservicenum_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Max<wbr>Service<wbr>Num</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Integer</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The maximum number of services in the cluster. Default is 256. The range is from 32 to 32768. When its power unequal to 2, it will round upward to the closest power of 2.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clustername_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clustername_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Name</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Name of the cluster.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusternodenum_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusternodenum_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Node<wbr>Num</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Integer</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Number of nodes in the cluster.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusteros_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusteros_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Os</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Cluster operating system, supports setting public images (the field passes the corresponding image Name) and custom images (the field passes the corresponding image ID). For details, please refer to: https://cloud.tencent.com/document/product/457/68289.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusterostype_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusterostype_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Os<wbr>Type</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Image type of the cluster os, the available values include: 'GENERAL'. Default is 'GENERAL'.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clustersubnetid_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clustersubnetid_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Subnet<wbr>Id</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Control Plane Subnet Information. This field is required only in the following scenarios: When the container network plugin is CiliumOverlay, TKE will obtain 2 IPs from this subnet to create an internal load balancer; When creating a managed cluster that supports CDC with the VPC-CNI network plugin, at least 12 IPs must be reserved.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusterversion_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusterversion_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Version</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Version of the cluster. Use <code>tencentcloud.Kubernetes.getAvailableClusterVersions</code> to get the upgradable cluster version.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_containerruntime_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_containerruntime_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">container<wbr>Runtime</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Runtime type of the cluster, the available values include: 'docker' and 'containerd'.The Kubernetes v1.24 has removed dockershim, so please use containerd in v1.24 or higher. The default value is <code>docker</code> for versions below v1.24 and <code>containerd</code> for versions above v1.24.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_dataplanev2_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_dataplanev2_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">data<wbr>Plane<wbr>V2</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Whether to enable DataPlaneV2 (replace kube-proxy with cilium). <code>dataPlaneV2</code> and <code>clusterIpvs</code> should not be set at the same time.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_deletionprotection_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_deletionprotection_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">deletion<wbr>Protection</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Indicates whether cluster deletion protection is enabled. Default is false.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_disableaddons_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_disableaddons_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">disable<wbr>Addons</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">List&lt;String&gt;</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>To prevent the installation of a specific Addon component, enter the corresponding AddonName.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_dockergraphpath_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_dockergraphpath_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">docker<wbr>Graph<wbr>Path</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Docker graph path. Default is <code>/var/lib/docker</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_domain_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_domain_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">domain</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Domain name for access.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_enablecustomizedpodcidr_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_enablecustomizedpodcidr_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">enable<wbr>Customized<wbr>Pod<wbr>Cidr</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Whether to enable the custom mode of node podCIDR size. Default is false.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_enisubnetids_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_enisubnetids_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">eni<wbr>Subnet<wbr>Ids</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">List&lt;String&gt;</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Subnet Ids for cluster with VPC-CNI network mode. This field can only set when field <code>networkType</code> is 'VPC-CNI'. <code>eniSubnetIds</code> can not empty once be set.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_eventpersistence_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_eventpersistence_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">event<wbr>Persistence</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type"><a href="#clustereventpersistence">Cluster<wbr>Event<wbr>Persistence</a></span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Specify cluster Event Persistence config. NOTE: Please make sure your TKE CamRole have permission to access CLS service.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_existinstances_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_existinstances_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">exist<wbr>Instances</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type"><a href="#clusterexistinstance">List&lt;Cluster<wbr>Exist<wbr>Instance&gt;</a></span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Create tke cluster by existed instances.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_extensionaddons_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_extensionaddons_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">extension<wbr>Addons</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type"><a href="#clusterextensionaddon">List&lt;Cluster<wbr>Extension<wbr>Addon&gt;</a></span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Information of the add-on to be installed. It is recommended to use resource <code>tencentcloud.Kubernetes.Addon</code> management cluster addon.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_extraargs_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_extraargs_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">extra<wbr>Args</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">List&lt;String&gt;</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Custom parameter information related to the node.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_globedesiredpodnum_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_globedesiredpodnum_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">globe<wbr>Desired<wbr>Pod<wbr>Num</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Integer</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Indicate to set desired pod number in node. valid when enable_customized_pod_cidr=true, and it takes effect for all nodes.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_ignoreclustercidrconflict_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_ignoreclustercidrconflict_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">ignore<wbr>Cluster<wbr>Cidr<wbr>Conflict</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Indicates whether to ignore the cluster cidr conflict error. Default is false.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_ignoreservicecidrconflict_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_ignoreservicecidrconflict_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">ignore<wbr>Service<wbr>Cidr<wbr>Conflict</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Indicates whether to ignore the service cidr conflict error. Only valid in <code>VPC-CNI</code> mode.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_instancedeletemode_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_instancedeletemode_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">instance<wbr>Delete<wbr>Mode</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The strategy for deleting cluster instances: terminate (destroy instances, only support pay as you go cloud host instances) retain (remove only, keep instances), Default is terminate.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_isdualstack_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_isdualstack_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">is<wbr>Dual<wbr>Stack</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>In the VPC-CNI mode of the cluster, the dual stack cluster status defaults to false, indicating a non dual stack cluster.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_isnonstaticipmode_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_isnonstaticipmode_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">is<wbr>Non<wbr>Static<wbr>Ip<wbr>Mode</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Indicates whether non-static ip mode is enabled. Default is false.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-secret"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_kubeconfig_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_kubeconfig_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">kube<wbr>Config</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Kubernetes config.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-secret"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_kubeconfigintranet_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_kubeconfigintranet_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">kube<wbr>Config<wbr>Intranet</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Kubernetes config of private network.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_kubeproxymode_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_kubeproxymode_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">kube<wbr>Proxy<wbr>Mode</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Cluster kube-proxy mode, the available values include: 'kube-proxy-bpf'. Default is not set.When set to kube-proxy-bpf, cluster version greater than 1.14 and with Tencent Linux 2.4 is required.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_labels_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_labels_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">labels</a>
</span>

<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clustermaxpodnum_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Max<wbr>Pod<wbr>Num</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">number</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The maximum number of Pods per node in the cluster. Default is 256. The minimum value is 4. When its power unequal to 2, it will round upward to the closest power of 2.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clustermaxservicenum_nodejs">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clustermaxservicenum_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Max<wbr>Service<wbr>Num</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">number</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The maximum number of services in the cluster. Default is 256. The range is from 32 to 32768. When its power unequal to 2, it will round upward to the closest power of 2.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clustername_nodejs">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clustername_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Name</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Name of the cluster.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusternodenum_nodejs">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusternodenum_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Node<wbr>Num</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">number</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Number of nodes in the cluster.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusteros_nodejs">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusteros_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Os</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Cluster operating system, supports setting public images (the field passes the corresponding image Name) and custom images (the field passes the corresponding image ID). For details, please refer to: https://cloud.tencent.com/document/product/457/68289.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusterostype_nodejs">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusterostype_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Os<wbr>Type</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Image type of the cluster os, the available values include: 'GENERAL'. Default is 'GENERAL'.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clustersubnetid_nodejs">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clustersubnetid_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Subnet<wbr>Id</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Control Plane Subnet Information. This field is required only in the following scenarios: When the container network plugin is CiliumOverlay, TKE will obtain 2 IPs from this subnet to create an internal load balancer; When creating a managed cluster that supports CDC with the VPC-CNI network plugin, at least 12 IPs must be reserved.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusterversion_nodejs">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusterversion_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Version</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Version of the cluster. Use <code>tencentcloud.Kubernetes.getAvailableClusterVersions</code> to get the upgradable cluster version.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_containerruntime_nodejs">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_containerruntime_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">container<wbr>Runtime</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Runtime type of the cluster, the available values include: 'docker' and 'containerd'.The Kubernetes v1.24 has removed dockershim, so please use containerd in v1.24 or higher. The default value is <code>docker</code> for versions below v1.24 and <code>containerd</code> for versions above v1.24.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_dataplanev2_nodejs">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_dataplanev2_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">data<wbr>Plane<wbr>V2</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Whether to enable DataPlaneV2 (replace kube-proxy with cilium). <code>dataPlaneV2</code> and <code>clusterIpvs</code> should not be set at the same time.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_deletionprotection_nodejs">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_deletionprotection_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">deletion<wbr>Protection</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Indicates whether cluster deletion protection is enabled. Default is false.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_disableaddons_nodejs">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_disableaddons_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">disable<wbr>Addons</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string[]</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>To prevent the installation of a specific Addon component, enter the corresponding AddonName.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_dockergraphpath_nodejs">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_dockergraphpath_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">docker<wbr>Graph<wbr>Path</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Docker graph path. Default is <code>/var/lib/docker</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_domain_nodejs">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_domain_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">domain</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Domain name for access.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_enablecustomizedpodcidr_nodejs">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_enablecustomizedpodcidr_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">enable<wbr>Customized<wbr>Pod<wbr>Cidr</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Whether to enable the custom mode of node podCIDR size. Default is false.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_enisubnetids_nodejs">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_enisubnetids_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">eni<wbr>Subnet<wbr>Ids</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string[]</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Subnet Ids for cluster with VPC-CNI network mode. This field can only set when field <code>networkType</code> is 'VPC-CNI'. <code>eniSubnetIds</code> can not empty once be set.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_eventpersistence_nodejs">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_eventpersistence_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">event<wbr>Persistence</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type"><a href="#clustereventpersistence">Cluster<wbr>Event<wbr>Persistence</a></span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Specify cluster Event Persistence config. NOTE: Please make sure your TKE CamRole have permission to access CLS service.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_existinstances_nodejs">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_existinstances_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">exist<wbr>Instances</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type"><a href="#clusterexistinstance">Cluster<wbr>Exist<wbr>Instance[]</a></span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Create tke cluster by existed instances.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_extensionaddons_nodejs">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_extensionaddons_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">extension<wbr>Addons</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type"><a href="#clusterextensionaddon">Cluster<wbr>Extension<wbr>Addon[]</a></span>
    </dt>

            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_extraargs_nodejs">

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string[]</span>
    </dt>

            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_globedesiredpodnum_nodejs">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_globedesiredpodnum_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">globe<wbr>Desired<wbr>Pod<wbr>Num</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">number</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Indicate to set desired pod number in node. valid when enable_customized_pod_cidr=true, and it takes effect for all nodes.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_ignoreclustercidrconflict_nodejs">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_ignoreclustercidrconflict_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">ignore<wbr>Cluster<wbr>Cidr<wbr>Conflict</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Indicates whether to ignore the cluster cidr conflict error. Default is false.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_ignoreservicecidrconflict_nodejs">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_ignoreservicecidrconflict_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">ignore<wbr>Service<wbr>Cidr<wbr>Conflict</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">boolean</span>
    </dt>

            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_instancedeletemode_nodejs">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_instancedeletemode_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">instance<wbr>Delete<wbr>Mode</a>

        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>

            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_isdualstack_nodejs">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_isdualstack_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">is<wbr>Dual<wbr>Stack</a>

        <span class="property-type">boolean</span>
    </dt>

            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_isnonstaticipmode_nodejs">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_isnonstaticipmode_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">is<wbr>Non<wbr>Static<wbr>Ip<wbr>Mode</a>

        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">boolean</span>
    </dt>

            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_kubeconfig_nodejs">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_kubeconfig_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">kube<wbr>Config</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>

<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_kubeconfigintranet_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">kube<wbr>Config<wbr>Intranet</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>

            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_kubeproxymode_nodejs">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_kubeproxymode_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">kube<wbr>Proxy<wbr>Mode</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>

            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_labels_nodejs">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_labels_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">labels</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">{[key: string]: string}</span>
    </dt>

            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_logagent_nodejs">

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type"><a href="#clusterlogagent">Cluster<wbr>Log<wbr>Agent</a></span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Specify cluster log agent config.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-deprecated"
            title="Optional, Deprecated">
        <span id="state_managedclusterinternetsecuritypolicies_nodejs">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_managedclusterinternetsecuritypolicies_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">managed<wbr>Cluster<wbr>Internet<wbr>Security<wbr>Policies</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string[]</span>
    </dt>

Security policies for managed cluster internet, like:'192.168.1.0/24' or '113.116.51.27', '0.0.0.0/0' means all. This field can only set when field <code>clusterDeployType</code> is 'MANAGED_CLUSTER' and <code>clusterInternet</code> is true. <code>managedClusterInternetSecurityPolicies</code> can not delete or empty once be set.<p class="property-message">Deprecated: this argument was deprecated, use <code>clusterInternetSecurityGroup</code> instead.</p></dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_masterconfigs_nodejs">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_masterconfigs_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">master<wbr>Configs</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type"><a href="#clustermasterconfig">Cluster<wbr>Master<wbr>Config[]</a></span>
    </dt>

<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_mounttarget_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">mount<wbr>Target</a>

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>

        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>

        <span class="property-indicator"></span>

        <span class="property-type">string</span>

<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_securitypolicies_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">security<wbr>Policies</a>

<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_unschedulable_nodejs" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">unschedulable</a>

    </dt>
    <dd>Specify Cluster Audit config. NOTE: Please make sure your TKE CamRole have permission to access CLS service.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clustercidr_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clustercidr_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Cidr</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>A network address block of the cluster. Different from vpc cidr and cidr of other clusters within this vpc. Must be in  10./192.168/172.[16-31] segments.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusterdeploytype_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusterdeploytype_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Deploy<wbr>Type</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Deployment type of the cluster, the available values include: 'MANAGED_CLUSTER' and 'INDEPENDENT_CLUSTER'. Default is 'MANAGED_CLUSTER'.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusterdesc_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusterdesc_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Desc</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Description of the cluster.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusterexternalendpoint_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusterexternalendpoint_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>External<wbr>Endpoint</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>External network address to access.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusterextraargs_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusterextraargs_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Extra<wbr>Args</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type"><a href="#clusterclusterextraargs">Property Map</a></span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Customized parameters for master component,such as kube-apiserver, kube-controller-manager, kube-scheduler.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusterinternet_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusterinternet_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Internet</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Open internet access or not. If this field is set 'true', the field below <code>workerConfig</code> must be set. Because only cluster with node is allowed enable access endpoint. You may open it through <code>tencentcloud.Kubernetes.ClusterEndpoint</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusterinternetdomain_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusterinternetdomain_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Internet<wbr>Domain</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Domain name for cluster Kube-apiserver internet access. Be careful if you modify value of this parameter, the clusterExternalEndpoint value may be changed automatically too.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusterinternetsecuritygroup_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusterinternetsecuritygroup_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Internet<wbr>Security<wbr>Group</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Specify security group, NOTE: This argument must not be empty if cluster internet enabled.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusterintranet_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusterintranet_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Intranet</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Open intranet access or not. If this field is set 'true', the field below <code>workerConfig</code> must be set. Because only cluster with node is allowed enable access endpoint. You may open it through <code>tencentcloud.Kubernetes.ClusterEndpoint</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusterintranetdomain_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusterintranetdomain_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Intranet<wbr>Domain</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Domain name for cluster Kube-apiserver intranet access. Be careful if you modify value of this parameter, the pgwEndpoint value may be changed automatically too.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusterintranetsubnetid_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusterintranetsubnetid_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Intranet<wbr>Subnet<wbr>Id</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Subnet id who can access this independent cluster, this field must and can only set  when <code>clusterIntranet</code> is true. <code>clusterIntranetSubnetId</code> can not modify once be set.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusteripvs_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusteripvs_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Ipvs</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Indicates whether <code>ipvs</code> is enabled. Default is true. False means <code>iptables</code> is enabled.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusterlevel_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusterlevel_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Level</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Specify cluster level, valid for managed cluster, use data source <code>tencentcloud.Kubernetes.getClusterLevels</code> to query available levels. Available value examples <code>L5</code>, <code>L20</code>, <code>L50</code>, <code>L100</code>, etc.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clustermaxpodnum_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clustermaxpodnum_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Max<wbr>Pod<wbr>Num</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Number</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The maximum number of Pods per node in the cluster. Default is 256. The minimum value is 4. When its power unequal to 2, it will round upward to the closest power of 2.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clustermaxservicenum_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clustermaxservicenum_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Max<wbr>Service<wbr>Num</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Number</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The maximum number of services in the cluster. Default is 256. The range is from 32 to 32768. When its power unequal to 2, it will round upward to the closest power of 2.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clustername_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clustername_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Name</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Name of the cluster.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusternodenum_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusternodenum_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Node<wbr>Num</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Number</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Number of nodes in the cluster.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusteros_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusteros_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Os</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Cluster operating system, supports setting public images (the field passes the corresponding image Name) and custom images (the field passes the corresponding image ID). For details, please refer to: https://cloud.tencent.com/document/product/457/68289.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusterostype_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusterostype_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Os<wbr>Type</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Image type of the cluster os, the available values include: 'GENERAL'. Default is 'GENERAL'.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clustersubnetid_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clustersubnetid_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Subnet<wbr>Id</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Control Plane Subnet Information. This field is required only in the following scenarios: When the container network plugin is CiliumOverlay, TKE will obtain 2 IPs from this subnet to create an internal load balancer; When creating a managed cluster that supports CDC with the VPC-CNI network plugin, at least 12 IPs must be reserved.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_clusterversion_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_clusterversion_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cluster<wbr>Version</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Version of the cluster. Use <code>tencentcloud.Kubernetes.getAvailableClusterVersions</code> to get the upgradable cluster version.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_containerruntime_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_containerruntime_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">container<wbr>Runtime</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Runtime type of the cluster, the available values include: 'docker' and 'containerd'.The Kubernetes v1.24 has removed dockershim, so please use containerd in v1.24 or higher. The default value is <code>docker</code> for versions below v1.24 and <code>containerd</code> for versions above v1.24.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_dataplanev2_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_dataplanev2_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">data<wbr>Plane<wbr>V2</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Whether to enable DataPlaneV2 (replace kube-proxy with cilium). <code>dataPlaneV2</code> and <code>clusterIpvs</code> should not be set at the same time.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_deletionprotection_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_deletionprotection_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">deletion<wbr>Protection</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Indicates whether cluster deletion protection is enabled. Default is false.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_disableaddons_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_disableaddons_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">disable<wbr>Addons</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">List&lt;String&gt;</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>To prevent the installation of a specific Addon component, enter the corresponding AddonName.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_dockergraphpath_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_dockergraphpath_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">docker<wbr>Graph<wbr>Path</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Docker graph path. Default is <code>/var/lib/docker</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_domain_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_domain_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">domain</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Domain name for access.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_enablecustomizedpodcidr_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_enablecustomizedpodcidr_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">enable<wbr>Customized<wbr>Pod<wbr>Cidr</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Whether to enable the custom mode of node podCIDR size. Default is false.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_enisubnetids_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_enisubnetids_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">eni<wbr>Subnet<wbr>Ids</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">List&lt;String&gt;</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Subnet Ids for cluster with VPC-CNI network mode. This field can only set when field <code>networkType</code> is 'VPC-CNI'. <code>eniSubnetIds</code> can not empty once be set.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_eventpersistence_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_eventpersistence_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">event<wbr>Persistence</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type"><a href="#clustereventpersistence">Property Map</a></span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Specify cluster Event Persistence config. NOTE: Please make sure your TKE CamRole have permission to access CLS service.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_existinstances_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_existinstances_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">exist<wbr>Instances</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type"><a href="#clusterexistinstance">List&lt;Property Map&gt;</a></span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Create tke cluster by existed instances.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_extensionaddons_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_extensionaddons_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">extension<wbr>Addons</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type"><a href="#clusterextensionaddon">List&lt;Property Map&gt;</a></span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Information of the add-on to be installed. It is recommended to use resource <code>tencentcloud.Kubernetes.Addon</code> management cluster addon.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_extraargs_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_extraargs_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">extra<wbr>Args</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">List&lt;String&gt;</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Custom parameter information related to the node.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_globedesiredpodnum_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_globedesiredpodnum_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">globe<wbr>Desired<wbr>Pod<wbr>Num</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Number</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Indicate to set desired pod number in node. valid when enable_customized_pod_cidr=true, and it takes effect for all nodes.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_ignoreclustercidrconflict_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_ignoreclustercidrconflict_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">ignore<wbr>Cluster<wbr>Cidr<wbr>Conflict</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Indicates whether to ignore the cluster cidr conflict error. Default is false.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_ignoreservicecidrconflict_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_ignoreservicecidrconflict_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">ignore<wbr>Service<wbr>Cidr<wbr>Conflict</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Indicates whether to ignore the service cidr conflict error. Only valid in <code>VPC-CNI</code> mode.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_instancedeletemode_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_instancedeletemode_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">instance<wbr>Delete<wbr>Mode</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The strategy for deleting cluster instances: terminate (destroy instances, only support pay as you go cloud host instances) retain (remove only, keep instances), Default is terminate.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_isdualstack_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_isdualstack_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">is<wbr>Dual<wbr>Stack</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>In the VPC-CNI mode of the cluster, the dual stack cluster status defaults to false, indicating a non dual stack cluster.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_isnonstaticipmode_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_isnonstaticipmode_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">is<wbr>Non<wbr>Static<wbr>Ip<wbr>Mode</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Indicates whether non-static ip mode is enabled. Default is false.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-secret"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_kubeconfig_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_kubeconfig_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">kube<wbr>Config</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Kubernetes config.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-secret"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_kubeconfigintranet_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_kubeconfigintranet_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">kube<wbr>Config<wbr>Intranet</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Kubernetes config of private network.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_kubeproxymode_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_kubeproxymode_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">kube<wbr>Proxy<wbr>Mode</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Cluster kube-proxy mode, the available values include: 'kube-proxy-bpf'. Default is not set.When set to kube-proxy-bpf, cluster version greater than 1.14 and with Tencent Linux 2.4 is required.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_labels_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_labels_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">labels</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Map&lt;String&gt;</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Labels of tke cluster nodes.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="state_logagent_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_logagent_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">log<wbr>Agent</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type"><a href="#clusterlogagent">Property Map</a></span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Specify cluster log agent config.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-deprecated"
            title="Optional, Deprecated">
        <span id="state_managedclusterinternetsecuritypolicies_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_managedclusterinternetsecuritypolicies_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">managed<wbr>Cluster<wbr>Internet<wbr>Security<wbr>Policies</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">List&lt;String&gt;</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>this argument was deprecated, use <code>clusterInternetSecurityGroup</code> instead. Security policies for managed cluster internet, like:'192.168.1.0/24' or '113.116.51.27', '0.0.0.0/0' means all. This field can only set when field <code>clusterDeployType</code> is 'MANAGED_CLUSTER' and <code>clusterInternet</code> is true. <code>managedClusterInternetSecurityPolicies</code> can not delete or empty once be set.<p class="property-message">Deprecated: this argument was deprecated, use <code>clusterInternetSecurityGroup</code> instead.</p></dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"

If this parameter is specified as <code>NOTIFY_AND_AUTO_RENEW</code>, the instance will be automatically renewed on a monthly basis if the account balance is sufficient. ## Import



tke cluster can be imported, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Kubernetes/cluster:Cluster example cls-n2h4jbtk
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
